speaker: 李
sentence: せっかくこないなとこまで来たんや。
literal: You went to the trouble of coming all the way out to a place like this.
official_neighbors: I'll tell you once I got it worked out. Till then, it stays secret. How do I get in touch with you once I'm ready?
Cabaret Grand. I'm there from evening on. I run the place.
You serious? You're the guy in charge of the Grand?
Next time you're thirsty, drinks're on me.
Heh, all right then. I'll get in touch tonight. What's your name?
Hey. Was wonderin' when you'd get here! Took ya longer'n I figured.
Heh heh, drop the scowl, friend.
You... You're tellin' me you expected me to find this place?
Eh, let's say it was a distinct possibility. See, I ain't yer average acupuncturist. God Hands, remember?
Whoa, hold up! You didn't think I'd let that one slide, did ya? I been waitin' for that east tile.
You just suck, buddy. Why don't ya give the newcomer there a turn?
You're in, right? Why else would anyone show up at a mahjong parlor?
See, I always wanted to play a round of mahjong with a hitman.
